column1: # libzstd 1.5.7's verdict on every bit flip of the ZC.4 differential's flip
# lane, recorded 2026-10-16 for docs/AUDIT-third-party-2026-10-15.md ZC.6 so
# the lane runs with no libzstd in the graph. The frames: tests/support
# FLIP_ROWS of sweep-zstd-1.5.7.zst, each as recorded (`on`) and with its
# checksum stripped (`off`, byte for byte what the CLI writes with
# --no-check). The flips: support `flip_bits` for each frame in that order,
# one XorShift seeded FLIP_SEED drawn through all of them.
# The oracle: a scratch crate outside the workspace, on the workspace lock's
# damaged frame through `zstd::Decoder::with_buffer` as the ZC.4 lane did.
# verdicts: one character per flip, in order: `E` libzstd refused it, `=` it
# decoded to the input, `W` it decoded to other bytes; wrong: for each `W`
# in order, the first 3 bytes of the SHA-256 of what libzstd decoded, in hex.
